warning.titlePre: Land Rover Range Rover P460e Oil Leaks & Coolant System Wear
paragraphs: The AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 is a sophisticated 3.0-litre inline-six with an integrated starter-generator and electric auxiliary compressor — a more modern and efficient design than the older AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 rebuild.
Because the Range Rover P460e uses a completely different engine family from the V8 M178 fitted to the Range Rover 63 and GT 63 S, parts and rebuild specifications don't cross over between them.
warning.source: Source: Established AJ300 turbo PHEV I6 specialist pattern — timing chain, bearing and gasket wear across integrated-starter-generator inline-six units.
